description: Primary production database became unresponsive at 10:00 AM. Affecting all customer-facing services.

comments.author: Alice Engineer
comments.body: Detected via monitoring alerts. Database not responding to health checks.

comments.author: Bob SRE
comments.body: Investigating - checking logs and recent deployments

comments.author: Bob SRE
comments.body: Found high CPU usage. Initiating failover to replica.
